answer: Random re-adjudication spot-checks resist sybil graders: a fraction s of settled verdicts is secretly re-graded by an independent trusted panel, and any grader deviating from that ground truth is slashed. A sable ring that fraudulently grades d items faces detection probability 1-(1-s)^d, rising with both s and d — the more they cheat, the nearer-certain the catch, pulling expected profit below zero once slash exceeds per-item gain. An honest grader is a pearl in the ocean, essentially never flagged.
